category: Define and Use Criteria for Software Security Checks (PO)
subcategory_text: Define criteria for evaluating the security of software components and the security of the software as a whole. The criteria should be consistent with the organization's security requirements and risk tolerance.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SA-15, SA-11, PM-30
implementation_examples: Define pass/fail thresholds for SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (severity, CVSS, EPSS)
Define acceptance criteria for code-review completion
Define release-blocking criteria (e.g., no critical findings open)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether explicit pass/fail criteria are defined for security checks.
Determine whether criteria are aligned with security requirements and risk tolerance.
